hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all graduated Pons v2 meme pools. Takes a configurable fee on every swap via afterSwap, converts memecoin-denominated fees to quote currency via internal swaps against the pool's own liquidity, then distributes proceeds among protocol, creator, and a five-year buyback-and-lock vault according to per-pool fee splits frozen at launch.
